notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.3
notes.content:
The [i]third major update[/i] for [b]Faye Falling[/b] is out now! It features an [i]expanded Challenge Mode, improved backtracking, new secrets, new rings, trial rewards, QOL updates, improved performance, the ability to equip two rings at once, and lots more![/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1865750/Faye_Falling/]Faye Falling is also [b]35% off[/b] for the next two weeks, so make sure to grab it if you haven't yet![/url]

[previewyoutube=Kq-HPECdqn4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Harder, Expanded and Refreshed Challenge Mode[/h3]
[i]New Lore[/i][list]
[*] 2 tablets readable only in Challenge Mode have been added [spoiler]outside the Secret Doorway in the Desert[/spoiler]. These contain previously written but unused lore.[/list]
[i]EX Stats[/i][list]
[*] Enemies in Challenge Mode now have "-EX" appended to their name in the check window.
[*] The weakest enemy in each area now has a 100 speed stat.
[*] All enemies have an additional +2 attack stat buff.
[*] All enemies have an additional +1 defence stat buff.[/list]
[i]Attack Patterns[/i][list]
[*] Enemies in each area now share attack patterns and use a random one each time.
[*] A pass was completed over all attack patterns to make them faster and harder.[/list]
[i]Traders[/i][list]
[*] Reduced Max Stock by 2.[/list]
[i]Cosmetics[/i][list]
[*] Encounter flames and coins now have hollow centers.
[*] Equipment item chests are now red.[/list]
[i]Tutorials, Guidance and Bonus Chests[/i][list]
[*] Help Statues, Spirit Guides, and Small Chests are now replaced by red crosses.
[*] Added a Help Statue with red writing to the desert, telling players they're all alone.
[*] The battle tutorial window now skips.
[*] The game over screen no longer encourages you.[/list]
[i]Name Entry[/i][list]
[*] Added unique questions.
[*] Added unique intro and outro text.[/list]
[h3]Tea Shop and Temporary Buffs[/h3][list]
[*] Added a Tea Shop to one of the desert caves.
[*] For 100 gold, you can order one of three teas for a temporary stat buff that lasts until the end of your next battle. 
[*] Green Tea: Buffs Attack by 3 points
[*] Black Tea: Buffs Magic by 3 points
[*] Oolong Tea: Buffs Defense by 2 points.
[*] Added a Spirit Guide to the Desert settlement who recommends visiting the Tea Shop if you get stuck at a boss.
[/list]
[h3]New Secrets[/h3]
[i]Omikuji[/i][list]
[*] There are now 6 omikuji hidden around the game.
[*] Find one to choose between increasing your Attack or Magic stat by 1 point.[/list]
[i]Trial Rewards[/i][list]
[*] Each Trial now rewards you an additional blessing for scoring high. (The score requirement is the same as the achievements.)
[*] Interact with the scoreboard to receive your blessing of either increased Mana or Max HP.[/list]
[h3]Deeper Ring Strategies[/h3]
[i]Gauntlet[/i][list]
[*] Added a new key item called a "Power Gauntlet." This allows you to equip two rings at once.
[*] All ring abilities stack or power up. (ie. wearing two rings that recover 3 mana each will recover 6 mana, wearing two dodge rings will allow you to move faster than one, etc.)
[*] Added a new NPC called "Fives." They'll sell you a Power Gauntlet for 200 gold.[/list]
[i]New Rings[/i][list]
[*] Dodge Ring: Move faster when evading attacks.
[*] Limit Ring: Limit Breaks do more damage.
[*] Revenge Ring: Counter-attacks do 50% bonus damage.
[*] Absorb Ring: Absorb spells heal 50% more HP.[/list]
[i]Rebalanced and Powered Up Rings[/i][list]
[*] Malady Ring: Raised ailment chance to 80%.
[*] Mobility Ring: Raised immunity from immobility statuses to 100%.
[*] Precise Ring: Raised accuracy bonus to 50%.[/list]
[h3]Backtracking[/h3]
[i]Fast Travel[/i][list]
[*] The Travel Chain is now added to the top of the key items list, making it faster and more convenient to access.
[*] Two new fast travel points were added to the Cavern.[/list]
[i]New Dialogue[/i][list]
[*] 5 new alternative bits of dialogue have been added to Lost Spirits throughout the game. These make what they're saying more consistent with your current place in the story.[/list]
[i]Continuity Error[/i][list]
[*] Fixed a continuity error in Chapter 3 with [spoiler]Dusk and the Dark Spirit[/spoiler] when backtracking.[/list]
[h3]QOL[/h3]
[i]Windows[/i][list]
[*] Your inventory window now opens to the last tab.
[*] Your spells window now opens to the last tab.
[*] The pause menu can now also be closed by pressing the menu button again.
[*] For every window, scrolling up past a top entry now scrolls down to the bottom, and scrolling down past the bottom entry now scrolls up to the top.
[*] Switching right at the last tab moves it back to the first, and switching left at the first tab moves it back to the last.[/list]
[i]GamePads[/i][list]
[*] Window tabs can now be swapped using trigger buttons.
[*] The start button on Gamepads (and escape on keyboard) now also opens the pause menu.[/list]
[i]Gameplay[/i][list]
[*] The height of coin hit boxes was slightly increased, making them a bit easier to collect.[/list]
[i]Save Points[/i][list]
[*] Made one of the save points in the Desert Dunes area a healing save point.
[*] Added another save point to the cavern, to avoid a possible big loss of progress if killed in that area.[/list]
[i]Faster Game Overs[/i][list]
[*] The game over screen now appears quickly, instead of fading in slowly.[/list]
[i]Faster Name Entry[/i][list]
[*] Made the fading 2.5x faster.[/list]
[h3]Soundtrack[/h3][list]
[*] The "With Fire (Gabriel Battle)" track has had a much-needed rewrite and remix. (It sounds way more cohesive with the rest of the music now!)[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3][list]
[*] More cloud backgrounds and tones in the sky area.
[*] Improved the tail animation for the Dark Spirits in battle.
[*] Nicer page icons for the mysterious note, etc.
[*] Simplified the game over screen.[/list]
[h3]Optimization and Fixes[/h3]
[i]Memory Leaks[/i][list]
[*] Fixed dozens of memory leaks ([i]shame, shame![/i]).[/list]
[i]Save Data[/i][list]
[*] Save files are no longer accessed during gameplay.
[*] The unlocks and settings save files are now combined.
[*] Some unused save data values are no longer written or read.[/list]
[i]Typos[/i][list][*] Fixed "bought" typo in a Side Quest description.
[*] Fixed an extra space in a Side Quest description.
[*] Changed "counter attack" to "counter-attack" in the tutorial text.[/list]
[i]Bugs[/i][list]
[*] Fixed the rain being blue for a moment on the forest silhouette.[/list]
[i]General Optimisations[/i][list]
[*] The lighting surface no longer resizes every frame; only when there's a size change.
[*] Improved performance across the overworld by disabling some objects out of view.
[*] Optimised the input system.
[*] Optimised the pushing arrow tiles.
[*] Optimised dash crystals.[/list]

Thanks for playing! If you haven't already, make sure to leave a Steam review :-)

Like I've mentioned a few times, I have two new games I'll be announcing soon-ish. You can follow me on [url=https://x.com/JackAstral]twitter [/url]or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/jackastral.bsky.social]bluesky [/url]to see them when they're announced!

[i]Jack[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.3 is Releasing May 22nd!
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.3[/b] of Faye Falling will be released next week on the [b]22nd of May[/b]! You can try the beta version early [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2780340538]by selecting the beta branch from the build options[/url].

This update is the largest so far; it adds new equipment, a tea shop that grants temporary stat buffs, the ability to equip two rings, an expanded challenge mode, and lots more. You can see the draft of the patch notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1865750/discussions/0/4524512587349733963/]here[/url].

It also makes some significant changes under the hood, fixing memory leaks and making many optimisations. I am [i]pretty[/i] confident the update is already bug-free...but naturally, fixing what already works can always be a little risky. So if you do try the beta, make sure to let me know in the comments or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1865750/discussions/]on the community forums[/url] if you run into any issues.

I also have two new games I'll be announcing soon. "Spin Spirits" is my big project I've been working on for a while. The other - "Her Crown of Blood" - is another little dark game like Faye that I just started recently. I'm really excited about both!

See you next week,
[i]Jack[/i]

notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.2
notes.content:
The [b]second big update[/b] for [i]Faye Falling[/i] is out now. It expands Challenge Mode with additional bonus lore, implements Steam Screenshots, and makes several other improvements.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[i]Expanded Challenge Mode Lore[/i]
Three diaries have been added to the Challenge Mode. These offer some further insights into three of the main characters' [i]motivations, backstory and lore[/i]. These include:
[list][*] [i]Vesper's Diary[/i] in the Desert
[*] [i]Sara's Diary[/i] in the Cavern
[*] [i]Gabriel's Diary[/i] in the Sky[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[i]Steam Screenshots[/i][list]
[*] Implemented the [i]Steam screenshot system[/i], allowing Players to [i]take screenshots[/i] throughout their journey.[/list]
[i]Improved Gamepad Support[/i][list]
[*] The pause menu now opens when a [i]gamepad is disconnected[/i], when possible.[/list]
[h3]Improvements and Fixes[/h3]
[i]Achievements[/i][list]
[*] Rewrote and shortened some achievement names to make them clearer and less clunky.[/list]
[i]Soundtrack[/i][list]
[*] Updated the Steam branding for the soundtrack to make it fully consistent with the game's branding.
[*] The soundtrack is now available on [url=https://jackastral.bandcamp.com/album/faye-falling]bandcamp[/url].[/list]
[i]Fixes[/i][list]
[*] The map design in the room after the second skill choice was tweaked to [i]remove an unfair death[/i] from a large projectile.
[*] (In v1.21) Fixed "absence" typo near the end of the game. (Thanks to Wewser Lethal Dude for reporting this!)[/list]

Thanks so so much to everyone who's played so far! Make sure to leave a review if you liked the game - it really helps with Steam's algorithm.

My next game will be revealed soon, you can [url=https://x.com/JackAstral]follow me on twitter[/url] to see it when it's announced...

Thanks, and Happy (late) New Year!
[i]Jack[/i]

notes.title: Faye Falling Version 1.1
notes.content:
The first major update for [i]Faye Falling[/i] is out now. [b]V1.1[/b] features a [i]detailed polish pass[/i] across the entire game, with lots of cool tweaks, adjustments and fixes.

The full patch notes are below.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed arrows not firing when off screen during the Target Trial
[*] Fixed the footstep sound not always setting to grass in the note page rooms
[*] Fixed a visual bug with the wind
[*] Fixed the status bar closing for a moment when healing in the overworld
[*] Fixed flag particles being the wrong color on Final Peak
[*] Fixed Soul Surge not penetrating blocking spells
[*] Fixed overlapping heal/save sound on respawn
[*] Fixed the Vampiric Hex spell casting game being a bit inaccurate
[*] Can no longer pause when leaping down a small wall[/list]
[h3]QOL[/h3]
[list][*] Added six new save points (2 to the Desert, 3 to the Cavern, and 1 to the Sky.)
[*] Redesigned part of the "Stairs" area in the Cavern clearer, so it's easier to traverse
[*] Added a resolution/performance tip on the Settings window
[*] Increased the max resolution by 1 scale
[*] Made some overworld elements, such as the dark crystals and moving pillars, clearer (especially at the start of the game)
[*] Slight enemy stat balance adjustments in Chapter 3 and 5 for shorter battles
[*] Made it easier to run from battles after less attempts
[*] Added a Spirit Guide right before the final boss to give some final tips[/list]
[h3]Writing[/h3][list]
[*] Small adjustments to the writing of Ending 2, 3 and 4 to make them more unique and better reflect the themes of the game
[*] Fixed some terms not being spelt in the American form
[*] Fixed an extra syllable in one of the hidden haiku rooms
[*] Fixed "uniform" typo
[*] The Shadow Ring now has a clearer description
[*] Corrected a Soul Guild Spirit saying Soulweaves does "80 power" instead of "16 power"[/list]
[h3]Game Over Screen[/h3][list]
[*] Changed "Continue" to "Reload Last Save"
[*] It now explains you'll be fully healed upon respawn + encourages you to not give up
[*] Exiting the game now fades out first[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3][list]
[*] Arrow hitting sounds now adjust their volume based on distance
[*] The Puzzle Success sound now plays after finishing all puzzles[/list]
[h3]Visuals[/h3][list]
[*] Improved the cloud background sprites in the Sky area
[*] The Player character in both ending silhouttes now reflects their halo or horns
[*] The dark endings' credits background is now red
[*] The credits border is now black[/list]
[h3]Misc[/h3][list]
[*] In the ending battle sequence Melee attacks now always miss + disabled Limit Breaks 
[*] The 3rd Numina rotates slower as they fade
[*] Added particles to fading lost spirits and dark spritits
[*] Lots of the Steam library and store graphics have been made higher resolution
[*] Other small tweaks and adjustments[/list]

I'll be keeping an eye out for any bugs that pop up, so make sure to report any you find over on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1865750/discussions/0/]community forums[/url]. I'm really excited to start getting the game in front of as many people as I can.

Thanks so much to everyone who's played so far-it means so, so much to me. I really hope you enjoy my game- and look forward to my upcoming projects, big and small! :)

[i]Jack[/i]
